_description: Shared WalletCore/WASM (packages/core) and RN-JS/ripple-binary-codec (packages/sdk) golden vector for an XRPL issued-currency Payment. Both suites read this file and independently derive the same signing hash. The amount carries the full 16 significant digits an XRPL token mantissa allows, so a rounding change in either encoder breaks this. Flags is explicitly zero because WalletCore serializes that optional field on its protobuf Payment path; omitting it is network-equivalent but changes the preimage and breaks mixed-platform MPC.
